stem: A retailer's marketing site is served through Amazon CloudFront with an origin hosted in the eu-west-1 Region, and the security team needs an ACM certificate the distribution can actually use for the custom domain over HTTPS. In which Region must the certificate be requested?

choices.text: The Region closest to the majority of the site's visitors
US East (N. Virginia), regardless of the origin's Region
Any Region, since ACM certificates are global resources

rationale: A certificate used with a CloudFront distribution must be requested in US East (N. Virginia) no matter where the distribution's origin lives, so that Region is the correct answer here. Requesting it in eu-west-1 to match the origin ignores CloudFront's specific requirement and CloudFront will not be able to use the certificate. Choosing a Region based on visitor location has no bearing on where a CloudFront certificate must be requested. ACM certificates are Regional resources, not global ones, which is exactly why CloudFront's requirement to use US East (N. Virginia) specifically matters.
